goal: Upgrade the Phase-1 placeholder rhythm-window to the full 5-band evaluator per docs/04 §3.3. Ships `src/game/combat/rhythm-window.ts` (NEW file alongside the existing `rhythm-window-placeholder.ts`) with the same `RhythmResult` shape AGENT-combat already shipped, but with all 5 quality bands (`critical | perfect | good | off | miss`). Widens the `RhythmQuality` union in `src/game/combat/types.ts` to include `'critical'` and `'off'`; existing 3-band placeholder callers continue to typecheck because their narrower union is a subset.
constraints: Pure function. No imports beyond local types.
Signature: `evaluateRhythmHit(nowMs: number, targetMs: number, focus: number): RhythmResult`.

RhythmResult shape is FIXED to what AGENT-combat already shipped in rhythm-window-placeholder.ts: `{ quality: RhythmQuality, damageMul: number, resReturn: number, deltaMs: number }`. Do not change the shape.
Update `src/game/combat/types.ts` `RhythmQuality` union from `'perfect' | 'good' | 'miss'` to `'critical' | 'perfect' | 'good' | 'off' | 'miss'`. Append-only — keep the existing three values.
Windows (delta = |nowMs - targetMs|): critical ≤40ms, perfect ≤80ms, good ≤160ms, off ≤300ms, else miss.
Focus widening: each window's tolerance is multiplied by (1 + min(focus,100)/200), max +50%.
Damage and RES modifiers per docs/04 section 3.3 table: critical=×2.0/+6 RES, perfect=×1.5/+4, good=×1.0/+2, off=×0.6/+0, miss=×0.2/+0 (and miss builds dissonance, handled by caller).
Document the function with a JSDoc reference to docs/04-COMBAT_SYSTEM.md §3.3.
Do NOT delete or modify `rhythm-window-placeholder.ts` — orchestrator handles caller migration + placeholder removal post-spec.
acceptance: Test covers every boundary (±1ms each), every quality level, focus=0 and focus=100 cases.
Test verifies focus=100 expands the critical window to ≤60ms.
